decisions.decision: Mount the board area in app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx rather than [boardId]/page.tsx
decisions.rationale: Next does not re-render the layout when only the [boardId] segment changes, so it survives a switch and paints from the cache entry with no server round trip. A board delivered as page output is a board the user waits for.

decisions.decision: Register the board entry's fetcher on the key family via setQueryDefaults(["board"], ...)
decisions.rationale: Several hooks deliberately declare no queryFn; with none carrying one mounted at fetch time the entry parks in 'No queryFn was passed' and can never revalidate. Pre-existing defect, measured on code predating this work.

decisions.decision: staleTime: Infinity plus an explicit invalidate on board change, not staleTime: 0
decisions.rationale: Zero made every observer's mount refetch; opening the task detail modal re-read the board and detached the input being typed into.

decisions.decision: Derive the unconfirmed-entity guards from TanStack's mutation cache, not a flag on the cached entity
decisions.rationale: The entity is merged over on success, so a flag would have to be un-set by hand; a mutation leaving pending retires its id on its own.

decisions.decision: isNil option 2 — migrate all 222 sites, then raise the rule to error
decisions.rationale: User's explicit choice after being shown the cost and the semantic risk. One site keeps the raw comparison behind a disable: createChildrenSerially treats undefined as a successful bodyless create and only null as unparsable.

It pinned nothing (passed on current code, no failing variant) and destabilised CI. Its finding does not reproduce: the create is issued before the move, so the server list already contains the row the index counted.
